post.summary: Fetch a blog listing by category
post.description:
Fetches a blog listing for a specific category. It also provides filters, sortings and property aggregations, analogous to the /search endpoint.

**Available Associations:**
- `downloads` - Downloadable files associated with the blog (e.g., manuals, digital content)
- `children` - Blog variants that inherit from this parent blog
- `deliveryTime` - Estimated delivery time for the blog
- `tax` - Tax configuration (rate and calculation rules)
- `manufacturer` - Blog manufacturer or brand information
- `unit` - Blog unit of measure (e.g., piece, liter, kg)
- `cover` - Main blog image displayed in listings and detail pages
- `openGraphMedia` - Open Graph image for social media sharing
- `cmsPage` - Custom CMS page layout for the blog detail page
- `canonicalProduct` - Canonical blog reference for variant consolidation and SEO purposes
- `media` - Blog images and media gallery
- `crossSellings` - Cross-selling configurations (related blogs, accessories, similar items)
- `configuratorSettings` - Variant configurator settings defining available options for blog variants
- `blogReviews` - User reviews and ratings for the blog
- `mainCategories` - Primary category assignments per sales channel for SEO and navigation
- `seoUrls` - SEO-friendly URLs for the blog across different sales channels
- `options` - Blog variant options (e.g., size, color) that define different variants
- `properties` - Blog properties and characteristics for filtering
- `categories` - Categories this blog is assigned to
- `streams` - Dynamic blog streams this blog belongs to based on defined filters
- `categoriesRo` - Read-only category tree including all parent categories for optimized queries
- `tags` - Tags for organizing and filtering blogs
- `seoCategory` - Main category used for SEO URL generation in the current sales channel

parameters.name: sw-include-seo-urls
parameters.description: Determines if the response must contain a SeoUrl entity for a blog entity

parameters.name: sw-include-search-info
parameters.description: Controls whether API search information is included in the response. Default is 1 (enabled), will be 0 (disabled) in the next major version.

200.description: Returns a blog listing containing all blogs and additional fields to display a listing.

400.description: The `Criteria` sent with the request is invalid, e.g. an unknown filter field, sorting field or association.

404.description: No category exists for the given `categoryId` in this sales channel.
